tool_input.command:
git add internal/daemon/handler_test.go internal/daemon/signature_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): convert remaining gpg t.Skip sites to t.Fatalf

Round-2 fix: the ratified design (docs/daemon-test-harness.md:663-676)
explicitly scoped this conversion to handler_test.go and
signature_test.go, but the mission's write-set omitted both files, so
they were never touched. All four `t.Skip("gpg not installed")` sites
now fail with the install remedy instead of skipping -- the same
failure mode (a test that silently skips locally is the same failure
as one that skips in CI) this whole tier exists to close, and gate 3's
own authority (TestVerifySignature) was skipping on exactly this path
until now.

handler_test.go's three inline exec.LookPath("gpg") + t.Skip blocks
(TestOnNewMail, TestOnNewMail_PGPKeyMismatch, TestOnNewMail_PGPKeyMatch)
now route through signature_test.go's existing gpgBinary helper instead
of each carrying its own copy -- fixed once, at the right level, rather
than four times.
EOF
)"
